notes.title: Cube Roller Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43680394/916c414eac568e6dc34c691ec5bf209a4a6fdd31.gif[/img]

yeah/nice is a new game development partnership between two brothers, Hunti and Aidan Ault. Cube Roller is the first game we've published after 3 years of small projects, teaching ourselves how to work in Unity and coming up with off-meta concepts to prototype and build on.

We're proud to finally be able to release the game and are stoked for what the future holds.

Please enjoy Cube Roller, and please go set some records!
